name: Kidung Reformed Injili
author: Andreas
description: Search, read and sing along to the 333 KRI hymns, offline

schema.label: Title display
schema.description: "elide" shows the number plus a truncated title; "number" shows the hymn number only. Either way the full title is in the tooltip.

schema.label: Max title width
schema.description: Pixels before the title is truncated. The hymn number is never truncated. 240 fits about 33 characters, showing 97% of hymn titles in full.
